title: yummy feremented green saudi-arabian lentil dal
description: a comforting, tender saudi-arabian dish featuring fermented green lentils and a rich flavour profile.

ingredients.name: green lentils
ingredients.notes: red or brown may be substituted but flavor profile will be altered.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: use filtered or spring water for best results.

ingredients.name: coconut oil
ingredients.notes: use non-hydrogenated and sustainably sourced oil for best results.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: any variety of onion may be used, but sweet and mild flavor will be best.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: mince before using to release oils and flavors.

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: grate or mince before using, 2 tablespoons fresh is equivalent to one tablespoon dried.

ingredients.name: cumin seeds
ingredients.notes: roast seeds before grinding for best flavor.

ingredients.name: coriander seeds
ingredients.notes: roast seeds before grinding for best flavor.

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper
ingredients.notes: adjust spice level to individual taste.

ingredients.name: fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: chopped or torn before garnishing, add as a garnish just before serving.

instructions: roast the cumin seeds and coriander seeds in a small pan over low heat until fragrant, stirring frequently.
grind the roasted seeds into a fine powder using a spice grinder or mortar and pestle.
heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, add the onion and sauté until translucent.
add the garlic and ginger to the saucepan, sauté for an additional minute.
